Here's the latest on Medtronic (NYSE: MDT):

## Recent Product & Regulatory News
- **Cardiac mapping/ablation (Sept 30, 2026):** Medtronic received FDA clearance and CE Mark for its **Affera Prism-2 Mapping Software**, plus a CE Mark for the **PulseSelect ProxBox Adapter** with Proximity Indicator — expanding its electrophysiology (EP) portfolio in the competitive pulsed field ablation (PFA) market. ([MedTech Dive](https://www.medtechdive.com/news/medtronic-reveals-cardiac-mapping-and-ablation-software-clearances/831852), [Medtronic](https://news.medtronic.com/2026-09-30-Medtronic-announces-regulatory-milestones-for-newest-cardiac-mapping-and-ablation-software))
- **Robotic surgery:** FDA clearance for the **LigaSure RAS Maryland** instrument on the **Hugo RAS** system (Sept 16, 2026). ([Today's Medical Developments](https://www.todaysmedicaldevelopments.com/news/regulatory-roundup-september-2026))
- **CPT codes (Oct 1, 2026):** AMA approved **Category I CPT codes** for the **Altaviva** tibial neuromodulation device (urge urinary incontinence) and **Symplicity Spyral** renal denervation system (hypertension), effective January 2028 — a potential long-term growth catalyst. ([PR Newswire](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/medtronic-receives-category-i-cpt-code-approvals-for-altaviva-and-symplicity-spyral-systems-302896491.html))

## Earnings & Financials
- **Fiscal Q1 2027 beat:** Revenue ~**$9.8B, up 13.7%** reported and organic (though an extra selling week added ~$570–670M). Adjusted EPS of **$1.45**, up 15.1% and beating estimates. ([Zacks/Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/medtronic-worth-buying-growth-improves-125800041.html))
- **Guidance raised:** Management lifted FY2027 organic revenue growth to **7.25%–7.75%** (from 6.75%–7.25%) and adjusted EPS to **$5.94–$6.00**. ([Insider Monkey/Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/medtronic-mdt-raises-outlook-again-143459144.html))
- **Segment growth:** Cardiovascular +19.5%, Diabetes +16.9%, Neuroscience +10.3%, Medical Surgical +10.0%.
- **Stock reaction mixed:** Shares fell ~6.4% since earnings, with Wall Street split on re-rating potential. Targets raised (Mizuho $115, Wells Fargo $104), but some remain Neutral. Cramer commented it looks cheap at ~14x earnings but lacked clear catalysts. ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/medtronic-mdt-q1-beat-sparks-180848561.html))

## Corporate / Strategic
- **Diabetes separation:** Progressing on a **$4B tax-free MiniMed exchange offer** following MiniMed's March 2026 IPO — though the offer appears to be losing investor appeal. ([MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/filing-medtronic-plc-mdt-shares-acquired-by-massmutual-private-wealth-trust-fsb-2026-10-05))
- **M&A / investments:** $700M investment in **Cornerstone Robotics**, plus acquisitions of **Scientia Vascular** and **SPR Therapeutics**.
- **Dividend:** 49-year streak of increases, ~3.27% yield. ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/medtronic-49-dividend-streak-faces-111532496.html))

**Bottom line:** Medtronic is showing its best growth acceleration in years (led by heart devices/cardiac ablation, up 88% worldwide), with raised guidance and a cheap ~14–15x forward valuation and >3% yield. The debate is whether the growth is durable enough to drive a re-rating, especially given the one-time extra selling week and the uncertain MiniMed spin-off.

Would you like a deeper dive into any specific area — earnings details, the diabetes separation, or analyst views?
